acceptedAnswer.text: A preconstruction consultation is an early planning meeting between a property owner and a general contractor before finalizing architectural blueprints or starting physical construction. During this session, we review your project goals, evaluate preliminary design concepts, and discuss site conditions. This meeting establishes a preliminary budget framework and pinpoints potential construction hurdles before you invest heavily in engineering. Involving a general contractor at this stage helps coordinate design goals with realistic material costs, avoiding costly plan revisions later on.
acceptedAnswer.description: A preconstruction consultation is an early planning meeting with a general contractor to review designs, evaluate site feasibility, and set realistic budgets before building starts.
